# proxmox_sdn_ipams (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN IPAMs from `/cluster/sdn/ipams`, sorted by `ipam`. Tokens are not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_ipams" "netbox" {
  type = "netbox"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Restrict the result to one IPAM type. An empty value disables this filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `ipams` (Attributes List) Matching IPAMs, sorted by `ipam`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipams))

<a id="nestedatt--ipams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipams`

Read-Only:

- `ipam` (String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `section` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
